description: This file defines the PHP class 'FilterGroup' which is a controller within the OpenCart administration panel, specifically managing filter groups in the catalog. It includes methods for listing, viewing, editing, and saving filter group data, and handles interactions with the model and view components of the MVC architecture.

classes.name: FilterGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing filter groups in the catalog section of the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for listing filter groups, handles filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of filter groups, formatted as view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the filtered, sorted, and paginated list of filter groups.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a filter group.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the submitted filter group data, either creating or updating.
